conflicts.topic: Permitted depth for marine placement / dumping
conflicts.source_a_statement: Persyaratan Lokasi Dumping: Terletak di laut dengan kedalaman > 50 meter.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Penempatan material keruk di sekitar lokasi penyiapan akses pada kedalaman perairan < 3 m (dredging context referenced).
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Numeric/operational contradiction in required water depth for placement activities ('>50 m' vs '<3 m').
conflicts.possible_explanation: The two statements refer to different activities: ENV-003 addresses dumping of drilling mud/cuttings (ex-situ dumping) while ENV-062 refers to placement/utilization of dredged material near access works. Different waste types and regulatory pathways commonly have different depth/location constraints.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires verification of activity-specific regulatory conditions and permit scopes.

conflicts.topic: Upstream/downstream distance for water quality sampling
conflicts.source_a_statement: Water quality sampling for dredged material utilization: sampling at 500 m upstream and 500 m downstream of dredged material utilization sites.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Stream water sampling: upstream 200 m and downstream 200 m from outlet/flotator.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different sampling distance prescriptions (500 m vs 200 m).
conflicts.possible_explanation: Sampling distance differs by monitoring objective and receptor type: ENV-001's 500 m appears tied to dredged-material utilization site impact assessment, whereas ENV-004's 200 m applies to routine stream outlet monitoring. The variance may be deliberate and activity-specific.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs confirmation whether different distances are intentional (by activity type) or inconsistent internal standards.

conflicts.topic: Numeric limit for oil & grease in produced/discharged water
conflicts.source_a_statement: Technical requirement: Minyak dan lemak 40 mg/L (presented as a limit).
conflicts.source_b_statement: Cites Perda Prov Kalimantan Timur No.02/2011: 40 mg/L for coastal; cites Permen LH 19/2010: 50 mg/L for offshore — both referenced as applicable in different contexts.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different numeric limits cited across documents (40 mg/L vs 50 mg/L) for oil/grease depending on regulatory source.
conflicts.possible_explanation: Multiple legal instruments apply depending on jurisdiction and receiving waterbody (regional Perda versus national Permen). The documents reference both as applicable in different spatial contexts (coastal vs offshore).
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires authoritative determination of which standard applies for each discharge location (regional vs national applicability).

conflicts.topic: Baku mutu for TPH in SBM over time
conflicts.source_a_statement: Baku mutu TPH <5% sampai tahun 2024, dan 0% pada tahun 2025 (SBM).
conflicts.source_b_statement: References Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 for mud/bore materials and dumping requirements but does not explicitly state these numeric TPH phase-out values.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: ENV-003 gives explicit numeric/temporal TPH limits while ENV-001 references the regulating ministerial rule without listing the same time-phased numeric limits.
conflicts.possible_explanation: ENV-003 may be citing an operational interpretation, permit condition, or company timeline derived from PerMenLHK No.6/2021 or from a separate regulatory update; ENV-001's extract simply lists the regulatory reference without repeating specific numeric timelines.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs cross-check against the cited PerMenLHK No.6/2021 text and current permit conditions to confirm the applicable TPH limits and dates.

conflicts.topic: Permitted depth for marine placement / dumping
conflicts.source_a_statement: Persyaratan Lokasi Dumping: Terletak di laut dengan kedalaman > 50 meter.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Penempatan material keruk di sekitar lokasi penyiapan akses pada kedalaman perairan < 3 m (dredging context referenced).
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Numeric/operational contradiction in required water depth for placement activities ('>50 m' vs '<3 m').
conflicts.possible_explanation: The two statements refer to different activities: ENV-003 addresses dumping of drilling mud/cuttings (ex-situ dumping) while ENV-062 refers to placement/utilization of dredged material near access works. Different waste types and regulatory pathways commonly have different depth/location constraints.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires verification of activity-specific regulatory conditions and permit scopes.

conflicts.topic: Upstream/downstream distance for water quality sampling
conflicts.source_a_statement: Water quality sampling for dredged material utilization: sampling at 500 m upstream and 500 m downstream of dredged material utilization sites.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Stream water sampling: upstream 200 m and downstream 200 m from outlet/flotator.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different sampling distance prescriptions (500 m vs 200 m).
conflicts.possible_explanation: Sampling distance differs by monitoring objective and receptor type: ENV-001's 500 m appears tied to dredged-material utilization site impact assessment, whereas ENV-004's 200 m applies to routine stream outlet monitoring. The variance may be deliberate and activity-specific.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs confirmation whether different distances are intentional (by activity type) or inconsistent internal standards.

conflicts.topic: Numeric limit for oil & grease in produced/discharged water
conflicts.source_a_statement: Technical requirement: Minyak dan lemak 40 mg/L (presented as a limit).
conflicts.source_b_statement: Cites Perda Prov Kalimantan Timur No.02/2011: 40 mg/L for coastal; cites Permen LH 19/2010: 50 mg/L for offshore — both referenced as applicable in different contexts.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different numeric limits cited across documents (40 mg/L vs 50 mg/L) for oil/grease depending on regulatory source.
conflicts.possible_explanation: Multiple legal instruments apply depending on jurisdiction and receiving waterbody (regional Perda versus national Permen). The documents reference both as applicable in different spatial contexts (coastal vs offshore).
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires authoritative determination of which standard applies for each discharge location (regional vs national applicability).

conflicts.topic: Baku mutu for TPH in SBM over time
conflicts.source_a_statement: Baku mutu TPH <5% sampai tahun 2024, dan 0% pada tahun 2025 (SBM).
conflicts.source_b_statement: References Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 for mud/bore materials and dumping requirements but does not explicitly state these numeric TPH phase-out values.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: ENV-003 gives explicit numeric/temporal TPH limits while ENV-001 references the regulating ministerial rule without listing the same time-phased numeric limits.
conflicts.possible_explanation: ENV-003 may be citing an operational interpretation, permit condition, or company timeline derived from PerMenLHK No.6/2021 or from a separate regulatory update; ENV-001's extract simply lists the regulatory reference without repeating specific numeric timelines.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs cross-check against the cited PerMenLHK No.6/2021 text and current permit conditions to confirm the applicable TPH limits and dates.

conflicts.topic: Permitted depth for marine placement / dumping
conflicts.source_a_statement: Persyaratan Lokasi Dumping: Terletak di laut dengan kedalaman > 50 meter.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Penempatan material keruk di sekitar lokasi penyiapan akses pada kedalaman perairan < 3 m (dredging context referenced).
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Numeric/operational contradiction in required water depth for placement activities ('>50 m' vs '<3 m').
conflicts.possible_explanation: The two statements refer to different activities: ENV-003 addresses dumping of drilling mud/cuttings (ex-situ dumping) while ENV-062 refers to placement/utilization of dredged material near access works. Different waste types and regulatory pathways commonly have different depth/location constraints.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires verification of activity-specific regulatory conditions and permit scopes.

conflicts.topic: Upstream/downstream distance for water quality sampling
conflicts.source_a_statement: Water quality sampling for dredged material utilization: sampling at 500 m upstream and 500 m downstream of dredged material utilization sites.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Stream water sampling: upstream 200 m and downstream 200 m from outlet/flotator.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different sampling distance prescriptions (500 m vs 200 m).
conflicts.possible_explanation: Sampling distance differs by monitoring objective and receptor type: ENV-001's 500 m appears tied to dredged-material utilization site impact assessment, whereas ENV-004's 200 m applies to routine stream outlet monitoring. The variance may be deliberate and activity-specific.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs confirmation whether different distances are intentional (by activity type) or inconsistent internal standards.

conflicts.topic: Numeric limit for oil & grease in produced/discharged water
conflicts.source_a_statement: Technical requirement: Minyak dan lemak 40 mg/L (presented as a limit).
conflicts.source_b_statement: Cites Perda Prov Kalimantan Timur No.02/2011: 40 mg/L for coastal; cites Permen LH 19/2010: 50 mg/L for offshore — both referenced as applicable in different contexts.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different numeric limits cited across documents (40 mg/L vs 50 mg/L) for oil/grease depending on regulatory source.
conflicts.possible_explanation: Multiple legal instruments apply depending on jurisdiction and receiving waterbody (regional Perda versus national Permen). The documents reference both as applicable in different spatial contexts (coastal vs offshore).
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires authoritative determination of which standard applies for each discharge location (regional vs national applicability).

conflicts.topic: Baku mutu for TPH in SBM over time
conflicts.source_a_statement: Baku mutu TPH <5% sampai tahun 2024, dan 0% pada tahun 2025 (SBM).
conflicts.source_b_statement: References Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 for mud/bore materials and dumping requirements but does not explicitly state these numeric TPH phase-out values.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: ENV-003 gives explicit numeric/temporal TPH limits while ENV-001 references the regulating ministerial rule without listing the same time-phased numeric limits.
conflicts.possible_explanation: ENV-003 may be citing an operational interpretation, permit condition, or company timeline derived from PerMenLHK No.6/2021 or from a separate regulatory update; ENV-001's extract simply lists the regulatory reference without repeating specific numeric timelines.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs cross-check against the cited PerMenLHK No.6/2021 text and current permit conditions to confirm the applicable TPH limits and dates.

conflicts.topic: Permitted depth for marine placement / dumping
conflicts.source_a_statement: Persyaratan Lokasi Dumping: Terletak di laut dengan kedalaman > 50 meter.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Penempatan material keruk di sekitar lokasi penyiapan akses pada kedalaman perairan < 3 m (dredging context referenced).
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Numeric/operational contradiction in required water depth for placement activities ('>50 m' vs '<3 m').
conflicts.possible_explanation: The two statements refer to different activities: ENV-003 addresses dumping of drilling mud/cuttings (ex-situ dumping) while ENV-062 refers to placement/utilization of dredged material near access works. Different waste types and regulatory pathways commonly have different depth/location constraints.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires verification of activity-specific regulatory conditions and permit scopes.

conflicts.topic: Upstream/downstream distance for water quality sampling
conflicts.source_a_statement: Water quality sampling for dredged material utilization: sampling at 500 m upstream and 500 m downstream of dredged material utilization sites.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Stream water sampling: upstream 200 m and downstream 200 m from outlet/flotator.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different sampling distance prescriptions (500 m vs 200 m).
conflicts.possible_explanation: Sampling distance differs by monitoring objective and receptor type: ENV-001's 500 m appears tied to dredged-material utilization site impact assessment, whereas ENV-004's 200 m applies to routine stream outlet monitoring. The variance may be deliberate and activity-specific.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs confirmation whether different distances are intentional (by activity type) or inconsistent internal standards.

conflicts.topic: Numeric limit for oil & grease in produced/discharged water
conflicts.source_a_statement: Technical requirement: Minyak dan lemak 40 mg/L (presented as a limit).
conflicts.source_b_statement: Cites Perda Prov Kalimantan Timur No.02/2011: 40 mg/L for coastal; cites Permen LH 19/2010: 50 mg/L for offshore — both referenced as applicable in different contexts.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different numeric limits cited across documents (40 mg/L vs 50 mg/L) for oil/grease depending on regulatory source.
conflicts.possible_explanation: Multiple legal instruments apply depending on jurisdiction and receiving waterbody (regional Perda versus national Permen). The documents reference both as applicable in different spatial contexts (coastal vs offshore).
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires authoritative determination of which standard applies for each discharge location (regional vs national applicability).

conflicts.topic: Baku mutu for TPH in SBM over time
conflicts.source_a_statement: Baku mutu TPH <5% sampai tahun 2024, dan 0% pada tahun 2025 (SBM).
conflicts.source_b_statement: References Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 for mud/bore materials and dumping requirements but does not explicitly state these numeric TPH phase-out values.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: ENV-003 gives explicit numeric/temporal TPH limits while ENV-001 references the regulating ministerial rule without listing the same time-phased numeric limits.
conflicts.possible_explanation: ENV-003 may be citing an operational interpretation, permit condition, or company timeline derived from PerMenLHK No.6/2021 or from a separate regulatory update; ENV-001's extract simply lists the regulatory reference without repeating specific numeric timelines.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs cross-check against the cited PerMenLHK No.6/2021 text and current permit conditions to confirm the applicable TPH limits and dates.

conflicts.topic: Permitted depth for marine placement / dumping
conflicts.source_a_statement: Persyaratan Lokasi Dumping: Terletak di laut dengan kedalaman > 50 meter.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Penempatan material keruk di sekitar lokasi penyiapan akses pada kedalaman perairan < 3 m (dredging context referenced).
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Numeric/operational contradiction in required water depth for placement activities ('>50 m' vs '<3 m').
conflicts.possible_explanation: The two statements refer to different activities: ENV-003 addresses dumping of drilling mud/cuttings (ex-situ dumping) while ENV-062 refers to placement/utilization of dredged material near access works. Different waste types and regulatory pathways commonly have different depth/location constraints.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires verification of activity-specific regulatory conditions and permit scopes.

conflicts.topic: Upstream/downstream distance for water quality sampling
conflicts.source_a_statement: Water quality sampling for dredged material utilization: sampling at 500 m upstream and 500 m downstream of dredged material utilization sites.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Stream water sampling: upstream 200 m and downstream 200 m from outlet/flotator.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different sampling distance prescriptions (500 m vs 200 m).
conflicts.possible_explanation: Sampling distance differs by monitoring objective and receptor type: ENV-001's 500 m appears tied to dredged-material utilization site impact assessment, whereas ENV-004's 200 m applies to routine stream outlet monitoring. The variance may be deliberate and activity-specific.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs confirmation whether different distances are intentional (by activity type) or inconsistent internal standards.

conflicts.topic: Numeric limit for oil & grease in produced/discharged water
conflicts.source_a_statement: Technical requirement: Minyak dan lemak 40 mg/L (presented as a limit).
conflicts.source_b_statement: Cites Perda Prov Kalimantan Timur No.02/2011: 40 mg/L for coastal; cites Permen LH 19/2010: 50 mg/L for offshore — both referenced as applicable in different contexts.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different numeric limits cited across documents (40 mg/L vs 50 mg/L) for oil/grease depending on regulatory source.
conflicts.possible_explanation: Multiple legal instruments apply depending on jurisdiction and receiving waterbody (regional Perda versus national Permen). The documents reference both as applicable in different spatial contexts (coastal vs offshore).
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires authoritative determination of which standard applies for each discharge location (regional vs national applicability).

conflicts.topic: Baku mutu for TPH in SBM over time
conflicts.source_a_statement: Baku mutu TPH <5% sampai tahun 2024, dan 0% pada tahun 2025 (SBM).
conflicts.source_b_statement: References Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 for mud/bore materials and dumping requirements but does not explicitly state these numeric TPH phase-out values.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: ENV-003 gives explicit numeric/temporal TPH limits while ENV-001 references the regulating ministerial rule without listing the same time-phased numeric limits.
conflicts.possible_explanation: ENV-003 may be citing an operational interpretation, permit condition, or company timeline derived from PerMenLHK No.6/2021 or from a separate regulatory update; ENV-001's extract simply lists the regulatory reference without repeating specific numeric timelines.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs cross-check against the cited PerMenLHK No.6/2021 text and current permit conditions to confirm the applicable TPH limits and dates.

workflow_steps: Coordinating and planning timelines with consultants for preparing RKL-RPL implementation reports and site surveys.
Submitting implementation reports into SIMPEL (Sistem Pelaporan Elektronik) KLHK and distributing final reports to relevant agencies.
Conducting biodiversity site surveys by environmental consultants with biodiversity experts (monitoring abrasi, flora & fauna, revegetasi, marine mammals, etc.).
Conducting societal site surveys via interviews with affected community members (petambak, nelayan, kepala desa, tenaga kesehatan).
Land acquisition steps including inventory of land status, coordination with government, socialization, compensation mechanisms, and approval for use of forest areas.
Use of WBM and SBM meeting requirements in Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021; sampling and laboratory analysis (KAN-accredited) of mud and waste before dumping or further handling.
Collecting and analyzing water quality samples (e.g., TSS) and comparing to baku mutu/tolok ukur; tabulation and descriptive analysis of data.
Management of dredged material including creation of containment ponds, drainage and planting mangrove after placement.
Plan timeline with consultants → conduct site surveys → compile data → submit report to SIMPEL KLHK → review and monitor implementation.
Generate field documentation (photos, records) during site support activities; maintain records of groundwater extraction and distribution.

Sampling workflow for drilling mud/waste: sample generation → KAN-accredited lab analysis (specified analytes) → compare with thresholds → either dump at designated location or bring to shore/manage further.

conflicts.topic: Permitted depth for marine placement / dumping
conflicts.source_a_statement: Persyaratan Lokasi Dumping: Terletak di laut dengan kedalaman > 50 meter.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Penempatan material keruk di sekitar lokasi penyiapan akses pada kedalaman perairan < 3 m (dredging context referenced).
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Numeric/operational contradiction in required water depth for placement activities ('>50 m' vs '<3 m').
conflicts.possible_explanation: The two statements refer to different activities: ENV-003 addresses dumping of drilling mud/cuttings (ex-situ dumping) while ENV-062 refers to placement/utilization of dredged material near access works. Different waste types and regulatory pathways commonly have different depth/location constraints.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires verification of activity-specific regulatory conditions and permit scopes.

conflicts.topic: Upstream/downstream distance for water quality sampling
conflicts.source_a_statement: Water quality sampling for dredged material utilization: sampling at 500 m upstream and 500 m downstream of dredged material utilization sites.
conflicts.source_b_statement: Stream water sampling: upstream 200 m and downstream 200 m from outlet/flotator.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different sampling distance prescriptions (500 m vs 200 m).
conflicts.possible_explanation: Sampling distance differs by monitoring objective and receptor type: ENV-001's 500 m appears tied to dredged-material utilization site impact assessment, whereas ENV-004's 200 m applies to routine stream outlet monitoring. The variance may be deliberate and activity-specific.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs confirmation whether different distances are intentional (by activity type) or inconsistent internal standards.

conflicts.topic: Numeric limit for oil & grease in produced/discharged water
conflicts.source_a_statement: Technical requirement: Minyak dan lemak 40 mg/L (presented as a limit).
conflicts.source_b_statement: Cites Perda Prov Kalimantan Timur No.02/2011: 40 mg/L for coastal; cites Permen LH 19/2010: 50 mg/L for offshore — both referenced as applicable in different contexts.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: Different numeric limits cited across documents (40 mg/L vs 50 mg/L) for oil/grease depending on regulatory source.
conflicts.possible_explanation: Multiple legal instruments apply depending on jurisdiction and receiving waterbody (regional Perda versus national Permen). The documents reference both as applicable in different spatial contexts (coastal vs offshore).
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — requires authoritative determination of which standard applies for each discharge location (regional vs national applicability).

conflicts.topic: Baku mutu for TPH in SBM over time
conflicts.source_a_statement: Baku mutu TPH <5% sampai tahun 2024, dan 0% pada tahun 2025 (SBM).
conflicts.source_b_statement: References Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 for mud/bore materials and dumping requirements but does not explicitly state these numeric TPH phase-out values.
conflicts.nature_of_conflict: ENV-003 gives explicit numeric/temporal TPH limits while ENV-001 references the regulating ministerial rule without listing the same time-phased numeric limits.
conflicts.possible_explanation: ENV-003 may be citing an operational interpretation, permit condition, or company timeline derived from PerMenLHK No.6/2021 or from a separate regulatory update; ENV-001's extract simply lists the regulatory reference without repeating specific numeric timelines.
conflicts.resolution_status: Unresolved — needs cross-check against the cited PerMenLHK No.6/2021 text and current permit conditions to confirm the applicable TPH limits and dates.
